deckinfo.name: Sylvan~Savior! 🜄🜁🜃
deckinfo.primer:
The overall goal is to abuse the synergy between Hamlet and Sylvan Splendor, cast a minion for 0/1, and draw a card, repeat until you dont see a cheap minion, cast assorted animals and grab some beasts, and continue the value train. get close to the enemy avatar and close the game with the swarm. anytime you cast a 0 cost minion, feel free to ward it. There is basically a ordinary 1 drop for every edgecase, playing against graves, grab a Carrion Beetles. Need to answer a ring of morrigan/core, Thieving Magpie. Need to summon those things on the opponents board, Ominous Owl/Spore Spouts. Sly Fox is great for stealth, scent hounds is great for removing stealth. etc etc

Goat is actually the GOAT, if you already have an established board, you can play him, ward him, swing, re-ward, swing, re-ward, etc, if you have a toolbox you can give the goat a barricade and become a true headache.

[[Lady Iseult]] adds another layer of combo potential with the [[Ring of Morigan]] it can cause plenty of infinite loops, notably your opponent will need to fully commit to dealing 20 damage to you in a given turn to door you.


Ward the Tufted Turtle, its funny, if it would take damage you can have its effect protect the ward. Shield maidens helps protect any/all wards from being pinged off. Goat protects all wards, and if you have shield maidens near it, theres a chance you can save its wards too :D


There are a lot of infinte combos in this list, mostly involving: lady issuelt, hamlet, sylvan splendor, horn of caerleon, Pnakotic Manuscript, the usual suspects.

deckinfo.name: Steam Savior - Unretired.
deckinfo.primer:
This deck takes advantage of the Saviors ability to ward non evil minions to generate advantage slightly after curve.


The basic premise of this deck is to cast things like lugbog, and the viper/puffer early to eastablish a defense but, what "early" means is instead of dropping a pond on turn 2 you drop it on turn 3 and ward the lugbog or turn 1 pond out a puffer/viper for free and cast the ward on it. The deck caps at 5 mana for most spells. Lords of Lies are the only 6 drops and can be mulliganed away on the opener.


Normally on an opener you are looking for a 1 mana beast and hopefully a 2-3 mana minion and a removal spell and for sites you are hoping for at least 1 pond and then just match needed threshold. If you prioritize getting to 6 mana can cast everything on turn WITH a ward on it.


This deck should act as mid range as possible and force your opponent to deal with your minions and their wards. Everything they use to break ward on your minions instead of killing them is card advantage. Each warded minion is essentially 2 creatures because of ward, because they have to deal with each minion twice that means 2 attacks, 2 spells, an attack and a spell - all of that is generating card advantage for you.


Be aggressive in your site defense by building a simple 4 square site set up. 6 sites should be the most you ever need to play.


Card draw is limited so card advantage is the wards. Try to use those to your advantage.

deckinfo.name: Savior Ward Value v2.2

Site placement: The first site you play should be an Earth site for the Root Spider, and play Water sites between your Earth sites for Call of the Sea.


Root Spider with Ward or Hammer counters other Root Spiders.


Use the Toolbox to get Just a Rock on the enemy Ring of Morrigan asap.


v2.2 - Added Plague of Frogs because it is too good.

v2.1 - Copied some general cards from other good decks.

deckinfo.name: *Seer - Sites Ablaze*
deckinfo.primer:
Post gothic brought some fun new toys for site destruction


The goal is to use hamlets Ablaze and sink holes to destroy the opponents middle site and then Replace it with a site of your own. and now also rift valley and earthquake. Play minions right up against their face and use extra strike effects for your 4,5 and 6 power minions. infernal legion is the MVP card you want mid to late game to play on that middle site and just push damage and the death blow built in. shatter strike is fun to get rid of their artifacts and push damage.


Root spider and basilisk are a fun way to disable and burn opponents minions to deaths while they can't move.


the plan is not to use the ablaze cards for minion removal, but if you can than that feels great and kinda funny.


this deck cares about Positioning over anything else.


shatter strike is clutch vs the high level of impactful artifacts we seen in the current meta



This Deck is a well balance mid range deck that is very FUN to play.


SEER without water should turn some heads



overall, it is a slow deck. can fumble to aggro without spiders or basilisk to help slow them down. 5 and 6 power feels nice coupled with 10 strike effect cards and you can push serious damage while hoping to be stronger than the majority of minions on the board.


Seer helps you find and hit threshold early on, but also lets you filter throughout the game so that if you have a 5 power minion in hand or on the board you can dig deeper to find a strike effect or vice versa and find a minion.


the common sense and toolbox package is a nice touch to add flexibly. ideal is turn 2 common sense for hamlets ablaze to cast on turn 3


thanks for reading

deckinfo.name: Lovecraft - Competitive Water Only
deckinfo.primer:
I'm a Bloodborne fan (it's my favorite game of all time) that fell in love with Sorcery after I learned I could play a Lovecraft deck. The challenge is making it a competitive deck, and that's what I'm constatly trying to do.


I tried making EVERY card lore friendly to Lovecraft, and I believe I've achieved that. We have great flooding events, we pull people and stuff underwater, we have monsters that come from underwater, Outer Gods, Great Old Ones, troubled towns and cosmic monsters. I decided to drop Air and focus on Water only because I kept running into threshold problems, either to cast the Air cards themselves or to cast high threshold Water cards.


I hope you enjoy it and that others help me improve it. Have fun!

deckinfo.primer:
Beeeg Spirits/Voidwalk deck


Using [[Seer]] to try and not be flooded with high cost in the early game, and find what I need in the late game.


Try to drop a big spirit early using [[Mix Aer]], [[Beacon]] and the Towers.

A lot of good high cost spirits are elites, so [[Major City]] is useful.


The water splash was originally just for [[Ghost Ship]], but now also adding AOE spells that Air lacks.

[[Shapeshift]] can get large minions down sooner, but if it misses then that means I'm closer to finding the big minions. [[Seer]] can help set up.


Combine [[Ghost Ship]] with [[Phantom Steed]] to make a recursive spirit engine.


---------------------------------------

  • [[Ether Core]]
  • [[Garden of Eden]]
  • The second [[Wuthering Heights]]

deckinfo.name: Wolves Gang!
deckinfo.primer:
The Wolf Gang is here!


So i dedicated myself to build a Wolf Deck which can handle most of the problems we meet in the Realm.

I played a lot of times against different Decks, and thought this one here is a lot of stress for the opponent, like, A LOT.


IMPORTANT: See below for budget variant's! Also, in SIDE DECK we discuss cards you can also put in!



UPDATE:


Moonsong Talagelum entered the pack!



Now, what are we doing?


Avatar:

We play the Basic Avatar, the Sorcerer. Due to "Hamlet", a Site which makes Ordinary Minions cost 1 less Mana, we have a few changes, like the "Doggo Charge" Combo. We need the Card draw from Sorcerer, its essential.


Mana / Threshold:

Most of the Time, if we have a Hamlet in the Realm, we can play with 3 Mana. Keep in mind, we play Earthquake, so if your enemy plays aggro too or has a lot of nasty tricks, try to reach 5 Mana. We need 2 Earth and 1 Wind threshold. Try to play a Hamlet on the border of an enemy site, or else we lose time from moving wolves later on.


Sites:

Like mentioned above, optimal play is 2 Earth, 1 Wind and a hamlet site. Our side deck has a lot of sites which can deal with different problems, speed, life gain and deleting site´s abilitys. Feel free to add some of them if needed. The Hamlet NEEDS to be on the border of an enemy site, if your Wolves have to move too much, you are screwed.


Card Draw:

Your Avatar makes you draw an extra Card per turn, keep your hand mostly empty so the Queen can draw you another card. We shouldn't forget to pull the removal cards from our Spellbook is important.


Removal:

Even if you will have easily a lot of Minions with Power greater than 5, your opponent can have things in the back row to make your life terrible, removal is important. Bury is simple enough, nothing to explain here, target annoying stuff or things that are stronger. Earthquake is the star of the show. Shuffle sites as you like and kill everything above, on top: Every Artifact is burrowed. Death Speaker and Battlemage hate this trick. You could also re-arrange the sites so you can hit an Avatar on deaths Door who tries to run away.

Lightning Bolt is a card you should use to end the game on Deaths Door quick, this way you don't need to run after the Avatar which can be annoying.


Minions:

Wolves aren't obvious to handle, you shouldn't necessarily bring all to one spot. You can scatter them a little to make a wall. It would be a nightmare if you leave everything on a single site and lose all Wolves. Remember, 3 wolves hit for 9(!) in a single turn, its insane! This leads us to the "Doggo Charge". We discussed the Queen earlier.


Doggo Charge:

Arthurian Legends brought us a lot of neat Relics. One of them is Horn of Caerleon. You

didn't thought Wolves love music? But they do! This is how it works: Play the Horn of Caerleon near an enemy site you want to attack. The trick is to do it when you have enough wolves in hand. So the Horn costs 4 Mana. If you have 4 Wolves in hand and a Hamlet in play, all of them can be played for 1 Mana each. This way, you are hitting for an immediate 16 dmg. And i know what you are thinking: Sounds like a lot of set up! Honestly? No, it doesn't. We have A LOT of card draw, we can cycle easily through our Atlas, so finding a Hamlet isn't hard. You could also put 4 Hamlets in it if you really want to. Now, just play it near your enemy. Next step, having some Wolves in hand - look at our Spellbook, we have plenty. The only thing hard to come by is the Horn, since it's elite. If you are really going for this combo, put 2 of them in it.



Solving the death Door:


Crusade, Lightning Bolt, Earthquake, Grapple Shot and Rift Valley can all win you the Game if you use it right. This is a tragic thing most Decks realize ones in this situation. Running after the enemy Avatar can be your own Death.



Starting the Game:


You want to start. If you draw your starting hand, make sure to throw away Wolves. You have enough, no need to start with 3 of em.

Starting with a removal would be nice.

For your Sites, try figuring out what you need to start. We only see 16% of our Atlas in a Game. Having a Windmill and a Hamlet is the best to begin with.


What are we afraid of?


You cant beat every deck, there is nothing like a perfect Deck. We hate mass removal, we play a lot of minions which benefit from each other. in our most powerful form we can draw 3 per turn and play 3 Wolves. But we don't try to get to this point, we should use the Time to win by then. A Grim Reaper is our Nightmare, kill it as soon as it enters the Realm. There are people which build Decks with only 10 Wolves because of this, i say this is nonsense. Yeah sure if he hits your Wolf, its over.


But:

  1. He is Unique, we wont see him often.
  2. We play fast, Games often wont last long.
  3. Its hard for Grim Reaper to hit immediatltey after being summoned.
  4. Because of 3, most of the time you have 1 turn to respond, so kill him with removal.
  5. Not everyone plays him, nor draws him.
  6. There IS a way to get rid of him, with Feast for Crows. But it's Unique!


Having a Deck with less than 20 Wolves makes them a waste of Deck space.



Experiments


Now, let us talk about experiments. You always can change small things from Deck lists, in the end its your choice what you play. So, what do i recommend to experiment with?


SIDE DECK:

In this topic, we look at cards you can put in if you don't like cards from the deck and look for other options. Most of em are getting rid of some problems, like getting flooded from your opponent.


Pnakotic Manuscript:

Can be used by a Wolf with 3 or more power in the back row so you can tap for additional cards, if your opponent has to deal with 3 new Wolves per turn, he will hate you. Pnakotic can kill your minions if you draw a high cost card, but we only have a few of them. Important: Look closely at your enemy Life, calculate when to use this artifact. You can use it by a Wolf, drop it and pick it up by another Wolf to use it again. This strategy can be critical if you need more cards and cant win on your next turn.


Lighting Bolt:

Additional removal, great to cast against defending Avatar at death Door, or even just to hit him a little. Also it kills many minions, if not, strike the unit with a Wolf to give it the rest.


Dispel:

Very good against Battlemage and Death Speaker. Those two guys often need their beloved artifacts.


Squirming Mass:

Funny if 3 Wolves die and this thing gets to 9 Power.


Problem Solving Sites:


Smokestacks of Gnaak to nullify sites

Pillars of Zeiros for Life Gain

Bedrock to avoid flooding and re-arranging

Imperial Road for Mana speed



Thank you very much for reading! This will get Updates sooner or later, i will Update things like other options to choose from!

deckinfo.name: Goth-Finwife Beckons
deckinfo.primer:
GARDEN OF EDEN***

in the list for threshold I CANT DECIDE IF I LIKE IT OR NOT I know it cooks sorcerer but it hurts interrogator too


NOW THAT BRUIN X DRUMS IS DEAD.... FINEWIFE WILL BECKON ONCE MORE!

Especially with the new spells in Gothic


Finwife will find true love.. if its the last thing she does


! 12th x-2 @ SORCERYCON !


11/3 - 12th place at Sorcery Con bubbled out of top 8! Went (5-2).. should have been 6-1 but King of the Realm top deck came in way to clutch for my opponent. Great game! Sorcery Con was such a good time.


10/30 - Finwife won my locals 19 people.. felt controlling







(testing needs slight update)






MAIN IDEA


Basically pull in their avatar with [[Led Astray]], [[Riptide]], [[Pudge Butcher]], [[Nelly Longarms]], or [[Coy Nixie]] and beat em up on our side of the realm! An early pull with [[Led Astray]] or [[Riptide]] sets up [[Finwife]]s ability allowing x2 draw early. Dont forget to play a land whenever possible tho if [[Finwife]] dies feels like a major blow without atleast 4 sites.


At this point in the deck the most important thing is threshold. Deck runs on 2 water + 2 earth threshold mainly. 2 water threshold is easy to get. Earth a little tougher, so mulligan whatever isn’t a troll bridge, Free City, or triple / dual land keeping atleast 1 earth site. Should feel pretty decent.


To be really effective finding a [[Troll Bridge]] or [[Free City]] opening hand really can put a lot of pressure pulling their avatar in early


(note: finwife only provides mana on play or start of turn as long as she is nearby an avatar doesnt work moving toward an avatar mid turn)


*primer might need some cleaning up but solid for now*



• AVATAR


[[Sorcerer]]

So much value the x2 draw brings its easy to forget site placement dont forget the get around 5 sites on board to help stick around late game and keep x2 drawing. IF [[Finwife]]s ability is active does help set up x2 draws a little sooner



• AURAS


[[Wall of Brambles]] (x3)

Can be very helpful for defense forcing minions to reconsider attacking from certain angles. Can stack to hit even harder. Using any of the forced movement spells [[Led Astray]], [[Riptide]], [[Coy Nixie]], [[Pudge Butcher]], or [[Nelly Longarms]] to force minions or especially avatars through the wall.


[[Atlantean Fate]] (x1)

Can be a game winner! Setting an opponents threshold to water only can hurt bad, especially if they don't run water spells. Just be careful ordinary sites not being affected can be tricky to play around at times.





• Artifacts


[[Aquamarine Core]] (x1)

Always nice to see early. Helps get the deck running a little faster. Simple and effective. Important for threshold help aswell.


[[Onyx Core]] (x1)

Helps just like [[Aquamarine Core]]. Maybe a little more important because earth threshold is a little harder to find


[[Philosopher’s Stone]] (x1)

Best card in the game. Helps cast more spells.


[[Ring of Morrigan]] (x1)

Need to test more just got one but from seeing it played against me it can win you the game helping with dealing extra damage to minions and healing you just enough to have a few more turns to win.


[[Truesight Crossbow]] (x1)

Mainly for when an opponent is at deaths door, can be a sneaky way to avoid blockers with a snipe. Seeing this late game is preferred but if you see it early play it on your avatar and wait it out. Avatars gain some range and can target stealth minions with spells. My favorite tech has been strategically placing either [[Plague of Frogs]] or my minions on board, in a way so that I can run a [[Truesight Crossbow]] from my avatar to whatever minion can tap in range for game.





• MINIONS


[[Adept Illusionist]] (x2)

A staple in any water deck for me. Just feels like so much value, constant chump blocks or damage. He is also a spellcaster so he can bring out his buddy ol’ pal and cast [[Ice Lance]] for game from further.


🌊[[Finwife]]🌊 (x3)

Always love to see baby girl. Using [[Riptide]] or [[Led Astray]] to pull avatar in range of her abilities activates the option for x2 draws from sorcerer earlier. [[Coy Nixie]] can help pull as well. Once enemy avatar is in range of ally site [[Finwife]] is essentially free and if not taken care of gives so much casting power.


[[Kettletop Leprechaun]] (x2)

If Avatar is pulled to ally side of the realm he can attack the avatar without dying and if something does take him out you draw a site for some advantage.


[[Lady Isuelt]] (x1)

Cycles cards back to hand. Trades feel even better. Gives a really solid hand advantage. Try not to play alone very often wait until the field is filled with a few ally minions to return to hand


[[Sneak Thief]] (x1)

Can put pressure on an avatar with any important artifact causing them to move to get away from this card and setting them back slightly. All the forced movement help set up the thievery! Can be used to sneak a final blow at Deaths Door with stealth. Once I used this ability to take an [[Iron Shackles]] off a stronger minion setting them free to attack!


[[Coy Nixie]] (x3)

Forced movement that can attack works really well here. Love pulling anything into the danger zones like [[Free City]], [[Troll Bridge]], [[Briar Patch]] or [[Wall of Brambles]]


[[Fey Changeling]] (x1)

Helpful for blocker removal and can set an opponent back a turn if they play some huge minion. Just send it back to the hand and continue on about your business. Sending certain genesis cards back to hand can be tricky so watch out for those.


[[Lugbog Cat]] (x3)

It’s extremely hard not to put 3 of these in every water deck. Just value. 3 cost 4 power can cast to any water site. Cast to an enemy back row water site if possible or even better back row on a [[Pristine Paradise]] and just attack


[[Nelly Longarms]] (x1)

Can be useful removal especially huge enemy minions. Sneak her around with [[Riptide]]s and pull enemy minions or avatars through all the dangerous traps. [[Free City]], [[Troll Bridge]], [[Briar Patch]] or [[Wall of Brambles]]


[[Sea Raider]] (x2)

Here for much needed card draw. Ability still works even if he dies attacking and is usually worth the sacrifice to help with hand advantage. Pull stronger minions onto [[Free City]], [[Troll Bridge]], [[Briar Patch]] or through [[Wall of Brambles]] to weaken then attack for draw.


[[Captain Baldassare]] (x1)

Here for extra draw similar to [[Sea Raider]]. Pure water list just need more draw and this gives some hand advantage, use enemy spells whenever possible.


[[Pirate Ship]] (x1)

Big 4 drop 5x5 beater. Really here to give better search options to [[Common Sense]]. Can be used almost like a [[Free City]] if water sites aren not connected. [[Floodplain]] can help with attacking.


[[Pudge Butcher]] (x3)

Love to see the big guy. Does a ton of damage in this list pulling enemy minions or especially an avatar onto [[Free City]], [[Troll Bridge]], [[Briar Patch]], or through [[Wall of Brambles]]. [[Riptide]] helps with sneaky hook angles.


[[Ruler of Thul]] (x1)

Top tier card giving +1 power to allies on the TOP and BOTTOM of the realm. Very good for sneak attacks for door especially with [[Plague of Frogs]].


[[Selfsame Simulacrum]] (x1)

Tech card! Love to copy pretty much any unique card in this list but pretty much if something is good on board copy it! Would run (x2) but really depends on something being on board and I hate having two in hand with no options to copy


[[The Green Knight]] (x1)

Can win you the game! Forcing the enemy movement and crushing smaller minions is so good I forget about the strike he does at deathrite! Feels best when played on a [[Free City]] or [[Troll Bridge]]. This card turn 3 + a [[Mix Aqua]] can really set the tone for a game.





• Magic


[[Plague of Frogs]] (x1)

Great defensively mainly, can buy some time. Crazy draw when paired with [[Pnakotic Manuscript]]. [[Ruler of Thul]] can turn these boys up +1 power for a sneak attacks. Can be used to run artifacts around to different units!


[[Common Sense]] (x1)

Hoping to use it to search for whatever I need in the moment. Early it feels good to grab a [[Pirate Ship]] for defense + a chance to attack if enemy runs water sites. Late game can grab [[Ice Lance]], [[Riptide]], [[Led Astray]] or even [[Duel]] to set up a final blow at deaths door.


[[Dispel]] (x1)

Useful tech gets rid of their pesky aura / cores / philosophers stone. Really whatever this can hit it always feels nice to get rid of it


[[Led Astray]] (x3)

Can be very crucial early pulling in an enemy avatar forcing them closer to the ally side of the board. Can be forced onto a [[Free city]] [[Troll Bridge]] [[Briar Patch]] or even through a [[Wall of Brambles]] + it helps [[Finwife]]s ability.


[[Polymorph]] (x2)

Banish the original minion so it never sees the cemetery leaving only a little baby enemy frog. Pairs really well with [[Sea Raider]] and [[Captain Baldassare]]. Solid removal for this deck with a lot of low power minions.



[[Riptide]] (x4)

Helpful movement spell for your own minions but it can also target enemies. Moving them out the way or closer for whatever you need. Can help facilitate a final blow at Deaths Door. [[Floodplain]] can help with range when needed especially forward as the second site flooding and pulling in an enemy avatar early. [[Finwife]] will be forever grateful.


[[Duel]] (x1)

Can help [[Pirate Ship]] and [[Pudge Butcher]] start fights through their restrictions of waterbound and immobility. Can also be used for a deaths door final blow as a way to get past blockers and extend attack range.


[[Ice Lance]] (x1)

Not my favorite Deaths Door spell but water and earth dont have a ton of options. Usually best to hold until late game for deaths door purposes. If found early in game can use in emergencies to get rid of some flying or huge minion threat. Being able to pierce and choose any target per space is very good but damage starts at casters location 3, adjacent site 2, next adjacent site 1. Range is a little weaker than I thought but still usually does the job. [[Adept illusionist]] work well being a spellcaster the 1st copy can bring out the 2nd and should be in range for a final blow.






• SITES


[[Aqueduct]] (x3)

Mandatory duel lands. Need both thresholds bad always a great keep opening hand.


[[Briar Patch]] (x3)

Helps with defense a small but helpful ping. Dragging through with [[Pudge Putcher]] or [[Nelly Longarms]] hurts and adds up over time. Move enemies in or out with a [[Led Astray]] or [[Riptide]]. Also keeps pesky 1 drop minions at bay like [[Sly Fox]] or buff frogs / foot soldier tokens


[[Caerleon-Upon-Usk]] (x1)

Tri-cite gives much needed threshold control. Only downside is it has to be back line which can sometimes get in the way of more aggressive site placement but worth it I think.


[[Floodplain]] (x3)

Can help with double or triple threshold water spells because flooding an ally or enemy site gives it a water threshold.

Combo with [[Riptide]] to pull in an avatar to ally side of the realm.

Combo with [[Free City]] and [[Riptide]] for added pressure


[[Free City]] (x3)

Helps make the deck more defensive but if [[Led Astray]] and [[Riptide]] are used correctly can pull an enemy avatar in and apply pressure. Place next to [[Floodplain]]s when possible to use [[Riptide]] to pull and attack. Combo with [[Nelly Longarms]] or [[Pudge Butcher]] to hit an avatar extra heavy and force them to waste movement to get off or stay and get beat up!


[[Kelp Cavern]] (x2)

I think of this as a better [[Observatory]], searching the bottom of the deck instead. Gives you more card selection and the much appreciated water threshold.


[[Mirror Realm]] (x1)

Really want to copy a tri/dual site. Can copy enemy site if they have the missing threshold needed. Wanting to sit around 2 water + 2 earth. Water being the more important threshold.


[[Pillar of Zeiros]] (x1)

God tier heal, has an earth threshold, and can counter fire / spark mage avatars using their grave as a charge or death speaker using everyone’s graveyard genesis


[[Rift Valley]] (x2)

Helps with early movement for your avatar to pull apart the original site and push the avatar out

Can be used aggressively to push an enemy unit closer or an ally minion further forward. Can help place sites closer to enemy avatar to set up [[Finwife]]s ability.


[[The Colour Out of Space]] (x1)

Best multi-threshold site. Can sometimes get shut off but once you find a good place for it in your play style it has more pros then cons


[[Tintagel]] (x1)

The other Tri-cite with earth and water. Need em for consistent threshold.


[[Troll Bridge]] (x3)

Staple for any water deck. Helps with defense and provides threshold. [[Led Astray]] or [[Riptide]]-ing someone into here feels great. Even better with a [[Wall of Brambles]].


[[Undertow]] (x2)

Can be used simply to move your avatar out of the middle lane early or to strategically move ally or enemy unit in a body of water. Can provide sneaky attack setups or even pull units onto a flooded [[Free City]] or through a well placed [[Wall of Brambles]]


[[Valley of Delight]] (x2)

Choosing whatever gets you closer to 2 water + 2 earth threshold faster. Water being the more important choice some spells requiring 3 threshold.


[[Wizard's Den]] (x2)

Draw + hand advantage is top tier. Even if you have to discard later in the game the draw was a card you didn't have before anyways and sometimes people arent even able to attack the site and its just a free draw. Very underrated be a must for me in pretty much any deck that isn't to threshold stressed







NOTES



STRONG AND SNEAKY.. love playing this list so far


Finwife is, no doubt, my new favorite card out of the new set

deckinfo.name: CHUNGUS: (1999)
deckinfo.primer:
CHUNGUS


Deck is HEAVY.. alot of push with some jank





OPENING HAND


Sites

Looking for ATLEAST 1 earth threshold to start preferably 2 earth and any tower (ex. [[Lone Tower]]). If possible a [[Free City]] or [[Vaults of Zul]] early is always helpful (playing [[Free City]] or [[Vaults of Zul]] turn one or two sets up the [[Pudge Butcher]] Avatar pull later real nice)

Deck mainly runs around 2 earth + 1 air threshold, earth heavy. [[Divine Healing]] does need 3 earth threshold but it’s not hard to get to after a draw or two with these ratios


Spells

More then anything else I love to see that [[Mix Terra]] and [[Pudge Butcher]] opening hand

ESPECIALLY with a [[Free City]] or [[Vaults of Zul]] but most times as long as you have 1 tower and an earth threshold, you’re looking for a [[Root Spider]], [[Vanguard Knight]], [[Phantom Steed]], and maybe a [[Grapple Shot]] for a turn 2 Tower with 3 mana to play any of those and apply pressure early







EVERY CARD AND WHAT I THINK





AVATAR


[[Sorcerer]]

Hard to beat the draw value [[Sorcerer]] can provide. Can be easy to abuse the double draw to early. Try to get to 5 sites when possible so you can cast the 5 cost spells then double draw all your little heart desires.




AURA


[[Crusade]] (x1)

Insane card a lot of options on play I like to place it touching both ally and enemy sites for +1 attack / defense. Just as well being able to attack the back row of sites is helpful too and will give an opponents avatar a tougher time escaping the +1 earth minions.





ARTIFACTS


[[Mix Terra]] (x1)

Helps burst out heavier cards great for an early [[Pudge Butcher]] combo’d hopefully with a [[Free City]] or [[Vaults of Zul]] early or for helping bring out the big boys

(Double drawing with one of these out feels real nice)


[[Philosopher’s Stone]] (x1)

Best card. Can help cast spells so much easier. All multiple color decks need this.


[[Magellan Globe]] (x1)

Crazy tech opens the game up so much the combos become insane

Feels risky every time I use this gives enemy alot of new options as well. I like to save until necessary.

Can also be used to give [[Pudge Butcher]] a new angle to yank an enemy


[[Pnakotic Manuscript]] (x1)

Any 5 power minion feels pretty decent drawing cards. Have a [[Squirming Mass]] nearby whenever possible just incase they pop. [[Land Surveyor]], [[Frontier Settlers]], or any smaller minion can be used




MINIONS


[[Frontier Settlers]] (x1)

Can really help speed up the deck. Just be sure to play him as safely as possible. Can even give him to [[Phantom Steed]] be safe out in the void and next turn free extra site.


[[Lady Isuelt]] (x1)

Cycles cards back to hand. Trades feel even better. Gives a really solid hand advantage. Try not to play alone very often wait until the field is filled with a few ally minions to return to hand.


[[Land Surveyor]] (x2)

Simple site draw allows for better threshold control and keeps you drawing spells. [[Pnakotic Manuscript]] this man to get even more value.


[[Miracle Workers]] (x1)

Hold until you need to trade + if a [[Squirming Mass]] is in the realm.


[[Sisters of Silence]] (x2)

Silence takes care of a lot, very oppressive

Can be used to move [[Dalcean Phalanx]] any direction or [[Pudge Butcher]] gets movement around too, takes away his immobility which is hilarious to me


[[Autumn Unicorn]] (x3)

Big beater card 4x4 Power not affected by [[Sisters of Silence]]

Very strong and a problem that has to be taken care of


[[Phantom Steed]] (x1)

Just for some tech, play [[Phantom Steed]] in the void adjacent to an ally site. Next turn, play a site under [[Phantom Steed]] so you can play a minion at that same location pick it up and take a valuable minion out to the void for protection during summoning sickness. (hard to target something out there) then get to attack using [[Phantom Steed]]s range.

Tested this out and it was awesome 3 steps and void usage was so clutch.


[[Root Spider]] (x2)

Just such a nuisance a lot of control I sometimes forget they can attack

only (x2), (x3) felt like it clogged up the deck to me


[[Squirming Mass]] (x1)

THE PROPHECY HAS BEEN FULFILLED THE TRUE CHUNGUS IS SQUIRMING MASS!!

Insane combos with [[Phantom Steed]] take out to the void for protection then dive bomb to help boost the MASS. Can be played in Gnome hallows for protection but he can get big enough to Deaths Door someone at full health.. CHUNGUS

Sadly going from (x2) to (x1) for now

0 power to start is easy to kill still love the tech but doesn’t last long usually


[[Vanguard Knights]] (x2)

Can always be played to protect Gnome Hollows

Very strong and a great push minion

I love to see opening hand with any tower plus [[Grapple Shot]]


[[Dalcean Phalanx]] (x3)

Used to not be a big fan but it’s always nice to see especially with the added [[Blink]]s and [[Grapple Shot]]s very effective


[[Pudge Butcher]] (x3)

Classic Pudge but I want to use him to drag their avatar to a [[Vaults of Zul]] or [[Free City]] site.

Can move to attack / defend when [[Sisters of Silence]] is nearby

[[BLINK]]s are this cards best friend play him to the side unassumingly and then pop him into range for a YANK!


[[Sir Perceval]] (x1)

His ability is not as good as I had hoped but it can still get a draw and is a decent target for [[Pnakotic Manuscript]]. 4x5 power is hard to beat alot of upside here


[[Amazon Warriors]] (x2)

here for one reason and that’s for a another common sense search option

Very strong 5x5 vanilla but pretty high cost going to test see how useful it can be


[[Sir Galahad]] (x1)

Threshold only needs to get to 2 air for one card, this man. Worth it for the health gain alone but whenever the protection happens its always a plus




Magic


[[Divine Healing]] (x2)

stay alive at all cost card +7 health


[[Blink]] (x4)

Unpredictable movement and getting untangled or unrooted and attacking feels very good

Want see it sneak a [[Pudge Butcher]] onto a [[Vaults of Zul]] or [[Free City]] to pull an avatar into the trap!



[[Common Sense]] (x2)

Hoping to use it to search for whatever I need in the moment. Early it feels good to grab an [[Amazon Warriors]] late game [[Grapple Shot]] is always helpful in this deck full of HEAVY hitters


[[Dispel]] (x1)

useful tech gets rid of their pesky aura / cores / stone whatever this can hit it always feels nice when it does.


[[Fade]] (x1)

Great after an attack to set up a unblockable attack next turn and get a nice draw. Can be [[Common Sense]]d for a final blow.


[[Lightning Bolt]] (x1)

Great win con or removal option

Only (x1) so make sure it’s worth it to use. [[Common Sense]] target great for final blow.


[[Bury]] (x1)

Great for removal + a secret burrow minion removal tech.. if you bury your own [[Sisters of Silence]] the sisters will die but anything nearby underground dies with her. [[Common Sense]] target when needed


[[Grapple Shot]] (x3)

A lot of big creatures to shoot over and smack

Can be used for game winning shot or move units around


[[Earthquake]] (x2)

clutch spell saves the day buries a bunch of minions advancing on you









SITES


Bedrock (x3)

Very strong site can’t be moved or blown up by other lands or spells

Cant be flooded keeping a safe spot for spiders

Great against [[Atlantean Fate]] and [[Roots of Yggdrasil]] decks


[[Dark Tower]] (x3), [[Gothic Tower]] (x3), [[Lone Tower]] (x2)

Gain extra mana for heavier pushes earlier. Perfect for turn 2 [[Root Spider]], [[Vanguard Knight]], [[Phantom Steed]].


[[Glastonbury Tor]] (x1)

Tri-cite. Simple. Has both earth and air threshold helps keep threshold under control.


[[Gnome Hollows]] (x1)

Feels good under the avatar defends against most attacks at least the heavy ones and defends against [[Battle Mage]] and djinn win con

Can be a hassle to move around but very helpful

Vanguard Knights can always be summoned here then grow to a 4 after entering.


[[Free City]] (x3)

One of my favorite cards since I first started playing insane value defense protection and attack

Combo with [[Pudge Butcher]] for heavy double attacks.


[[Holy Ground]] (x1)

+3 healing whenever possible, stay alive!


[[Pillar of Zeiros]] (x1)

God tier heal, has an earth threshold, and can counter fire / spark mage avatars using their grave as a charge or death speaker using everyone’s graveyard genesis


[[Rift Valley]] (x2)

Helps with early movement for your avatar to pull apart the original site and push the avatar out

Can be used aggressively to push an enemy unit closer or an ally minion further forward


[[The Colour Out of Space]] (x1)

Best multi-threshold site. Can sometimes get shut off but once you find a good place for it in your play style it has more pros then cons


[[Tintagel]] (x1)

The other Tri-cite with earth and air. Need em for consistent threshold.


[[Valley of Delight]] (x2)

Pick whatever threshold gets you closer to 2 earth 1 air first. After that 2 earth 2 air max is all you need.


[[Vaults of Zul]] (x1)

Spiciest tech in the deck, jank if you will, but I want to [[Pudge Butcher]] their avatar onto it and hit them hard as I can for two turns

I had someone on deaths doors I entered the [[Vaults of Zul]] myself and drew 3 cards into the answer I needed! A lot of weird options here

(Could be a tower or any other spicy land)


[[Windmill]] (x3)

Constant Pressure & Constant Damage - Overwhelm the Opponent!!!


*This is my first brew that I started the game with.. Initially it was 3 elements because I liked too many cards.

I figured out quickly back then that It was going to be a lot tougher to run 3 colors in this game in comparison to my Esper brew in MTG at the time.

I wanted to be sure to cover all angles but in the end it was too clunky..

When AL dropped I was able to put some more focus into this brew with all of the new cards that came out.

Fire/Water cards really stood out in the set so I decided to still with Fire and continue the Earth path as it felt safe.

I almost went Fire/Air based on how fast you can get your opponents to Death's Door with those elements combo..

Decided not to, and to keep my aggressive playstyle but with a midrange gameplay in mind.

Formidable Yes, but far from perfect.. I always feel like this one can use some adjustments here and there..

Nonetheless, this one is for sure up for debate when it comes to my "Strongest Brew" and I'll continue to work it until it can't be worked no more!*


This brew really aims to chip you down unless you're opponent can't keep up with the board presence.. in that case, they're getting ran over.

There is lot's of unaccounted for damage that can be done during turns past 4 due to all of the Charge minions.

It's best to stray from grouping with these minions as most of them don't need each other to work.

You'll want to hit multiple sites from different angles rather than pushing straight forward and letting yourself get cleared.

Removal can be tough for this brew if you happen to overextend on your plays so play your minions wisely.

Sorcerer: [🔥/💧] Midrange Combo Brew

Sneaky Combos That Lead To HEAVY DAMAGE!



NEW SEASON NEW ME! [TESTING]








*My first attempt at a Fire + Water brew without Elementalist.

Decided rather than going for a more straight forward aggro build with Fire that I would use the Fire for Movement/Chip Damage early.

Also instead of using Water for control, I wanted to use Water for more pressure with the combos that can be done.*


The key is to get some damage in where you can while also minimizing damage as much as possible.

Pick and choose where to play your Dragons and Cats early to extend the game.

Play your spellcasters up front to cast removal that's too far for your Avatar.

This brew plays heavy combos around 5-6 mana, so it's best to get setup by then to hit big OTK combos when least expected.

The Cores really help when they are drawn early to get those combos going sooner rather than later and Philosopher's Stone will forever be a blessing.

You don't need to OTK in this build to win.. however there are multiple options when it comes to hitting them in game.



MVP CARDS

  1. Yokai Kappas
  2. Helpful Hob
  3. Sword and Shield
  4. Warp Spasm
  5. Leap Attack


Honorable Mentions

  • Plague of Frogs
  • Boudicca
  • Ruler of Thul


MVP COMBOS

  • Yokai Kappas + Sword and Shield + Warp Spasm (This combo here is an OTK that can be done on Turn 6 so long as you have a Water Site in hand.)
  • Yokai Kappas + Helpful Hob + [Water Site] (This combo feels much better with a Sword and Shield equipped, but 9 damage for 4 mana seems really good.)
  • Sir Agravaine + Plague of Frogs (This combo can OTK you if you're not ready.. Play the Frogs and Swing with them at Leader/Minions and let Agravaine Jump in for 3 every time a frog swings. This feels good with Jihad on board.)
  • Boudicca + Plague of Frogs (This is another one that can sneak up on you if you're not ready. Door by turn 4 potentially.)
  • Leap Attack + Any 5 Power Minion (Every time I hit this it feels SO good! Having the Sword and Shield helps the 3 Power minions in the build get there so they don't feel left out.)
  • Warp Spasm + Any 5 Power Minion + Helpful Hob (BIG CHONKY BOY DAMAGE!)


Death's Door Finishers

  • Heat Ray/Firebolts being the obvious ones if in position with your Avatar, Adept Illusionist, or Morgana le Fey.
  • Fire Breathing due to having said spellcasters above along with 6 Beast/Dragon Targets to cast from is a solid game winner in here. (Can be cast by the frog tokens too.)
  • Colicky Dragonette can shoot for 1 to win the game when placed in the right spot.
  • Ring of Morrigan by being close enough and playing any card to win the game seems fair.
  • Minor Explosion just in case..


There are plenty of combos that can be done with other cards in the build, the ones above are just some that I built the deck around and some I've performed in game that I actually liked.

Some really good cards in here but there is also some sleeper cards in the brew which I'm also a fan of!

All in all this deck has been really fun and pretty consistent.

Will update periodically with changes.


*Please let me know if you happen to run the deck and how it goes in the comments.

Thanks in advance.* 1-800-DID-iCOOK?

After opening a box of Alpha and four boxes of Beta I have 17 Grey Wolves so I'm starting there; however, I expect I will be adding more to the deck. deckinfo.name: Love and Thunder (Competitive Sparkmage)
deckinfo.primer:
Pre-AL build when decks where only 40/20:

Pre-AL Competitive Sparkmage | by @Metroidpikmin. (curiosa.io)


Casual Version:

Sparkmage Aggro | by @Metroidpikmin. (curiosa.io)


The plan is to use [[Sparkmage]] offensively, using cantrips and other low cost spells to play 1-2 spells a turn letting Sparkmage deal 2-4 damage. Before Minions are accounted for.


The key cards are [[teleport]] and [[blink]], the deck wins with sparkmage, and getting Sparkmage close without tapping so you can use that ability is key. [[Kythera Mechanism]] is the best card in the whole deck, let's just get that straight. [[Sparkmage]], [[Lightning Bolt]], [[Thunderstorm]], [[Headless Haunt]], and [[Raise Dead]] all have the word random Mechanism puts in a lot of work, letting you hit what you want to hit. There are a couple of other notable cards, [[poisonous dagger]] lets Sparkmage kill any minion letting you deal with 5 plus power minions easily. [[Highland Princess]] grabs Mechanism or a core. Really all of the cards serve a purpose. With all the cards except the artifacts, blink and lightning bolt all being two air threshold puts a lot of work in. [[Gyre Hippogriffs]] are a great 4 drop as if you can use the Sparkmage ability for 4 mana you can deal 5 damage. They are also great for closing out a match


This deck is aggro, but not the win turn 3 or 4 kind of aggro. This is an aggressive deck once you have a mana you teleport near your opponent and start zapping them for 2-6 a turn. You can win fast but the deck wants to get to 4 mana and stay there. Then from there get close, cast spells to build up the threshold, and tap for damage. I love casting teleport, then lightning bolts and tapping to deal 3 with Sparkmage, if all of that hits the opponent's avatar you just did 6 damage in one turn, before taking into account minions you have out.


Try to place the stall sites, [[Great Wall]], on row two to by you time to get to 4 to 6 mana. And don't be afraid to retreat with [[Cloud City]] or a [[Teleport]] if it keeps you alive longer, the [[Angel's Egg]] can do a lot.


Don't be afraid to hard mulligan your spells, you need teleports in your hand.


All of the minions in the deck are to help you keep pressure and let you deal 2 with [[Sparkmage]].


Feel free to play around with the number of [[Phase Assassin]] and [[Haast Eagle]] the two are quite interchangeable. [[Phase Assassin]] is more on the aggro side because of Voidwalk, whereas [[Haast Eagle]] is a better defensive play especially with [[Updraft Ridge]]. Both are hard to remove because of the Stealth and Airborne respectfully.


Site Placement Strategies: I would recommend playing sites only in the back row, this lets you stall an additional turn before taking damage. If you play [[Great Wall]] as your first site it will stall out two turns as they would need to play 4 sites before their minions can attack your sites (unless they have airborne minions).
